x: Bain scored a victory for the L.A.C. by beating Arthur Allum, although the latter showed he is far from being a spent force. In the one field event F.
One of our pre-war second claim members, Frank Norman, has returned to the Club as a first claim member now, and with steady training next season should be showing some good performances.
In the 1 Mile Medley Relay, Blowfield ran a really good race behind Pettet of the Police but they could not catch the T.V.H. boy over the final half-mile stage. F.
In the Field Events several new title holders were seen, and Alan Dunn is to be complimented on bringing off a fine double in winning the Javelin and Discus events. F.

Frank Norman, our Long Jump Champion of last year, has also suffered from injuries and has not been able to turn out often. He, however, gained places in the Essex County Long and Hop Step and Jump Championships.
In the club handicap events, the 100 yards was won by Geoff. Osmint (7½); 2nd F.
